speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency). The clinical triad of primary amenorrhea, virilization (clitoromegaly, maternal hirsutism), and bone fragility (due to chronic androgen excess) is characteristic of this condition.
